title: I must have tried to use this with the wrong ...
text: I must have tried to use this with the wrong .... I must have tried to use this with the wrong rubbermaid containers.  I tried to push the container onto the little holder and I broke the peg under it.  Note to everyone considering purchasing this, it is not for regular rubbermaid containers.  You should buy a new set containers so they are all the same size or you won't really save space.  It can only hold 2 stacks. You need deep drawers to use this.

product_metadata.title: YouCopia StoraStack Food Container Storage and Drawer Organizer
features: Store and organize 12 containers and 12 matching lids (not included) in a drawer
Fits plastic food containers from grocery store brands like Ziploc, Glad, Rubbermaid TakeAlongs and Target Up&Up
Includes two clip dispensers for container stacks; dividers keep lids separated and ready for use
DOES NOT FIT Rubbermaid Premier and Easy Find Lid Storage and Tupperware non disposable storage
No permanent installation required; Expands to lock into standard kitchen drawers 18-5/16" to 21-5/16” Deep. Measures 7-3/8" Width x 4-1/2" Height.
description: StoraStack is a unique solution for storing and organizing food containers in a kitchen drawer. Two clip dispensers hold containers in place and individual slots store matching lids upright so everything stays tidy and easy to find. It is designed to fit plastic, nested containers with lids that snap (not twist or clip). Top grocery store brands including Ziploc, Glad, Rubbermaid TakeAlongs and Target Up&Up make containers that fit nicely and can be replaced as needed. The Drawer StoraStack is a patented solution that will help you stay organized!
